facts.claim: Seabourn Venture (Seabourn): Entered service 2022; 23,000 GT; 260 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 233 m length; Expedition class.
Seabourn Venture is an ultra-luxury expedition cruise ship operated by Seabourn Cruise Line.
Sea trials began in April 2022 and the ship was delivered to Seabourn Cruise Line on 28 June 2022 in Genoa.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Seabourn; entered service 2022; 23,000 GT; approx. 260 guests at double occupancy.
